meta.phase: Phase 0 — Positioning, Landscape Sweep & Competitive Deep Dive

evidence_grading.1: Primary — government publications, official statistics, official pricing pages, statutes, our own interviews/pilot data
evidence_grading.2: High-quality secondary — IIM/IIIT research, established consulting, World Bank/OECD, peer-reviewed
evidence_grading.3: Market intelligence — Tracxn, Crunchbase, Factly/Dataful, SaaS directories (G2, Capterra, GetApp)
evidence_grading.4: Community — vendor blogs, LinkedIn, Reddit, YouTube, review-site excerpts

reliability_markers.VERIFIED: read directly from a primary source
reliability_markers.NOT_PUBLIC: gated behind login or sales call
reliability_markers.UNVERIFIED: could not be confirmed; do not cite externally

grades.DOCUMENTARY: proven from a government primary source that the work exists and what it demands
grades.INFERRED: strongly implied by documentary evidence but not itself observed
grades.ASSUMED: plausible, stated in todo.md, not yet evidenced at all

meta.warning: We have interviewed ZERO institutions. No problem below is yet validated in the todo.md sense.

records.evidence: The IIC portal has NO venture-entity module - its 17 menus contain no CRM, pipeline or portfolio object (GOV-018). NIRF asks for startups as ROWS - name, DPIIT number, funding amounts, year - per discipline, per year (GOV-028). YUKTI-NIR holds a SNAPSHOT in three buckets (GOV-023).
records.inference: The only place a venture exists as a trackable entity over time is the institution's own private records - which by Phase 0 evidence is Excel or WhatsApp (COMP-024, COMP-026).
records.still_needs: How many institutions actually maintain a venture register today, in what format, updated how often, by whom.

records.evidence: 16+ activities/year minimum: 12 IIC Calendar (3/quarter) + 4 Celebration (1/quarter), plus ALL MIC-driven activities (GOV-020). Each activity requires FOUR social media links (Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn), participant counts split three ways, EXPENDITURE IN RUPEES, overview, objective, benefits, remark, VIDEO URL, TWO PHOTOGRAPHS and a document upload (GOV-021). Levels 1-4 by contact hours determine scoring weight. 'Conducting the event alone will not secure the stars - the activity you have conducted should be approved by the IIC.'
records.inference: Council meeting minutes must be uploaded for the quarter - minimum TWO per academic year, each with a signed Resolution listing every member and their responsibilities, a quarterly plan, minutes with President and Convenor present, and a photograph. VERBATIM: 'If it is in red cross then you cannot add any activity under Manage Activity section.' (GOV-019)
records.still_needs: How much the council-meeting dependency actually costs in practice, and whether it is resented or accepted.

records.evidence: MIC trained 60,000+ faculty as Innovation Ambassadors (GOV-007). The IIC dashboard separately counts student council members, student idea submissions, and faculty Innovation Ambassadors. AY 2025-26 annual reports are self-labelled 'IIC 8.0', indicating the programme has versioned at least eight times, each with new tracking expectations.
records.inference: No commercial platform has a first-class faculty or innovator entity - all eleven build from 'startup application' (Positioning_Map Gap 6). Faculty are the SOURCE of everything downstream: inventions -> disclosures -> patents -> licences -> startups.
records.still_needs: Whether faculty innovation management is a felt pain or a compliance checkbox.

records.evidence: The IIC portal has 'Manage Pre-Incubation / Incubation Details' - and it registers THE FACILITY, NOT THE INCUBATEES: floor-area and existence metadata for pre-incubation centres, incubation centres and IPR/TTO Centres (GOV-022, GOV-018). YUKTI-NIR grades innovations into TRL bands but holds no cohort.
records.inference: Scale of the underlying estate: 3,249 IPR/TTO offices, 5,157 pre-incubation and 3,083 incubation facilities (GOV-007); 103 AIC+ACIC centres incubating 6,782 startups (GOV-008); 517+ MeitY Startup Hub incubators (GOV-012). A national estate of thousands of registered facilities, none of which has a mandated system recording who is in them.
records.still_needs: Actual occupancy rates per centre. Published figures give facilities, not cohort sizes.

records.evidence: The IIC portal's 'Manage Mentor-Mentee Program' is a SCHEME PARTICIPATION FORM - no session calendar, no matching, no outcome capture, no goal tracking (GOV-022). By contrast MAARG, the national mentorship platform, has AI matchmaking, session scheduling, cohort programmes and dashboards - but is SCOPED TO DPIIT-RECOGNISED STARTUPS, not institutional portfolios (GOV-041).
records.inference: The compliance dimension nobody has: mentors are often external, requiring conflict-of-interest declaration, NDA and IP non-disclosure BEFORE seeing any pre-incubation idea; must log attendance and hours against scheme utilisation rules (NIDHI/BIRAC/CSR fund mentors' time); must sign a confidentiality agreement - exactly what AICTE's own YUKTI-NIR NDA templates address ('PATENT / INVENTION NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT'); subject to conflict checks against their own IP and startup holdings. A SINGLE NDA LEAKAGE COULD VOID AN IPR CLAIM.
records.still_needs: Actual mentor session volumes and how they are currently logged.

records.evidence: THE BEST-EVIDENCED PROBLEM AREA IN THE PROJECT. (1) The IIC portal registers an 'IPR/TTO Centre' by existence and floor area and has NO FIELD to record a single patent (GOV-022). (2) NIRF Innovation requires 'Patents Commercialized and Technology Transferred' and 'Income from Technology Transferred (in Rupees)' by calendar year (GOV-028). (3) ARIIA requires per innovation: 'Patent Application No', 'Year of Patent Application', 'Current Status', 'IP / Patented Technology' - verified in a real institutional submission (GOV-032). (4) KAPILA: 2,746 institutes registered; 11,768 patents reimbursed with Rs 380 lakh funding; reimbursement raised to 100% (Rs 5,600) for up to 100 patents/institution from FY 2024-25 (GOV-007). (5) NATIONAL HEI PATENT FILINGS ROSE 119% IN TWO YEARS - 15,383 (FY23) to 33,675 (FY25) (GOV-007). (6) MeitY's official playbook mandates IP due diligence: ownership clarity, freedom to operate, defensibility, and distinguishing ownership from a limited-term (2-year) university tech-transfer licence (GOV-038). (7) IIT Madras runs an IP Management Cell covering early-stage disclosures, prior-art evaluation, drafting, prosecution and long-term portfolio management, filing 431 PATENTS IN ONE YEAR (352 international, 79 Indian), plus a TTO (COMP-027). (8) NIDHI-PRAYAS requires an institutional No Objection Certificate confirming IP vests entirely with the innovator or startup (GOV-037). (9) ZERO of eleven direct competitors have any IPR module.
records.inference: The chain is complete and citable: institutions are mandated to report patent-level data to three different bodies, filing patent applications at a 119% two-year growth rate, with a dedicated NOC requirement for IP vesting - and NO MANDATED SYSTEM ANYWHERE HOLDS A PATENT RECORD. Institutions maintain a private register and re-type it by hand every year.
records.still_needs: Walk through the last patent filing end to end. We have never observed one being done.

records.evidence: 3,249 IPR/TTO offices, 5,157 pre-incubation and 3,083 incubation facilities registered with IIC - floor area only (GOV-007). ISERD/Atal labs: 10,000+ ATLs across 733 districts (GOV-009). MeitY Startup Hub supports 329+ labs (GOV-012).
records.inference: This is the ONE area with strong incumbents: incuTrack does room inventory, key control, work orders, visitor/lobby management, lease and insurance tracking (COMP-010); EcoSync does five office-space pricing tiers with deposits, recurring rent, Razorpay payouts, and day-of-week slot booking with approval (COMP-003). Strategic note: we should NOT compete here, and it is the most likely source of a free/defensive feature.
records.still_needs: Whether facility contention is a felt pain or just a phone call.

records.evidence: Gohorto's own framing captures the buyer pain precisely: 'Universities don't just run isolated programs; they manage a complex ecosystem that includes: Incubator -> Accelerator -> Hackathon -> Entrepreneurship courses -> Grant programs -> Industry partnerships. Each of these areas has different teams, budgets, and timelines.'
records.inference: Institutional scale: Kerala operates 375+ IEDCs across colleges and universities with 27 R&D institutions and 63 incubators (GOV-042) - a single state running hundreds of sub-institution programmes. IIC requires 16+ activities/year each with a full evidence submission (GOV-020, GOV-021).
records.still_needs: How many programmes a typical IIC runs concurrently.

records.evidence: AND IT IS A DEVASTATING NEGATIVE. The IIC dashboard's 'Overall Impact' is defined as TOTAL STUDENTS AND FACULTY WHO BENEFITED FROM ACTIVITIES - event attendance headcount, not venture outcomes. There is NO jobs, revenue, survival or graduation metric anywhere in the mandated stack (GOV-018).
records.inference: AN INSTITUTION CANNOT ANSWER 'HOW MANY OF OUR INCUBATEES ARE STILL ALIVE?' FROM ANY GOVERNMENT SYSTEM. This is the strongest possible statement of the gap - and simultaneously the problem area with the LEAST primary evidence from us.
records.still_needs: EVERYTHING. Nobody has yet been asked how they currently monitor performance. PHASE 3 PRIORITY #1.

records.evidence: The full obligation stack: IIC council meetings (min 2/yr, signed resolutions, quarterly plans, minutes, photographs - AND THEY GATE EVERYTHING ELSE); IIC activities (16+/yr, each a full evidence submission); YUKTI-NIR (every innovation/startup, TRL-banded, institute-verified, FLOWS INTO ARIIA); NIRF Innovation (~11 screens PER DISCIPLINE); ARIIA (100+ indicators, 5 categories); NIDHI/DST/BIRAC (grant utilisation, audited certificates, PFMS/CGA registration, unspent-balance refund); AISHE (binary NIRF status, plus the institution is the REGISTRY - the AISHE code everything else keys off).
records.inference: NO INTEGRATION EXISTS. The only de-duplication is ARIIA's one-directional fetch from IIC/NISP/YUKTI - 'has reduced data submission efforts at the institute level by checking redundancy' (GOV-031) - which does NOT cover NIRF-I and shows NO EVIDENCE OF AUTO-POPULATION in submitted NIRF forms. NO PUBLIC API, DEVELOPER DOCUMENTATION OR BULK EXPORT ENDPOINT EXISTS for IIC, YUKTI, NIRF, AISHE or MAARG (GOV-043). Corroborating signals of institutional friction: AISHE self-declaration that 'the data is self-reported by the HEIs'; 77.4% standalone-institution response (the weakest category); AISHE 2024-25 reopened for data error rectification until 24 Dec 2025; 69,233 separate compliances and 6,618 independent filings under ~1,500 Acts.
records.still_needs: Hours per month actually lost. See OQ-12 - no one has quantified this.

records.evidence: Credential fragmentation is severe and documented. A single venture can hold CIN (MCA) -> DIPP (DPIIT) -> KSUM UID (Kerala) -> IIC ID -> AISHE code -> NIRF institute_id -> ARIIA ID -> SAKALA (Karnataka). NO CANONICAL IDENTIFIER SPANS THESE (GOV-025, GOV-042). 'IIC login credentials and the YUKTI login credentials are different.'
records.inference: State portals are independent silos with their own registration, ID, login and form taxonomy, and NONE exposes an API a system of record could write to. 31 of 36 states have a startup policy, 27 developed after Startup India (GOV-015) - so 27+ separate policy frameworks the institution must track. Data quality is already imperfect BEFORE any join: Factly's government-derived dataset has 204 institute_id values against 202 institute_name values - a 0.98% dirty-record rate (GOV-030).
records.still_needs: How many separate logins an IIC coordinator currently maintains.

records.evidence: NIRF Innovation: 5 marks of the final Innovation score hinge on ONE COUNTABLE - DPIIT-recognised startups in the previous 3 years. VC investment weight dropped 25->20; a new government seed-funding line appeared; Patent Commercialization and Technology Transfer was REMOVED from Innovation Achievements and replaced by 'Alumni Founders of Forbes/Fortune 500' (GOV-027). ARIIA: 100+ indicators, 5 categories, annual; YUKTI-NIR 'Recommended' innovations auto-pool into Section 4 (GOV-024, GOV-032). IIC star rating displayed on every portal page header as a headline institution attribute (GOV-018). SRF 5.0: 34 S/UTs, 19 Action Points, 6 Reform Areas; per-state reports surface institutional support metrics (GOV-035). NIDHI/DST: proposals assessed on 'inability to get adequate number of incubatee, frequent leaving of incubatee, inability to meet targets'.
records.inference: STRONGEST SINGLE ECONOMIC SIGNAL IN THE PROJECT. Any product that improves an institution's national ranking sells into a budget line that already exists (D-007).
records.still_needs: OQ-10 - the IIC star-rating formula is not publicly documented. The official help page returns 'Coming Soon.' FEATURE RISK.
